title: Subash
desc: Subhash, an unemployed young man, joins the army to be able to marry his lover. However, when he returns from his deployment, he is shocked to see his brother leading a corrupt life.

title: Varusham 16
desc: Kannan, a teenager, falls in love with his uncle's daughter, Radhika, but things turn upside down when her grandmother disapproves of their relationship.

title: Thambi Pondatti
desc: Somu, a photographer, works with female models. Later, when he gets married to a conservative girl, she becomes wary of his proximity with the models.

title: Saavi
desc: Latha, a wealthy socialite, is married to Vijaykumar, an ex-tennis player. After spotting his wife with another man, Vijaykumar makes a plan to murder her, which goes terribly wrong.

title: Sigappu Thali
desc: Sadayan does errands for his fellow villagers and lives off their generosity. Soon, a series of circumstances compels him to help Kalamani, the daughter of the head of the village.
